reviewVerdicts.rationale: Question 1 is no. The review skill requires each round's complete file contents to be returned (workspace/.agents/skills/review/SKILL.md:48-55). The claimed final dry round (backend-review.log:39768, summarized at :40246) used `Get-Content ... -Raw | Out-Null` for the scoped configuration, source, and test files (backend-review.log:39561-39679), so those contents were not returned or examined in that round. The required gate was also not clean: `pnpm check:watch rebuild` failed with TS5042 (backend-review.log:31084), and the later `pnpm check:watch` ended by timeout 124 (backend-review.log:35572); the final report acknowledges this at :40246. Question 2 is no. The workspace testing contract requires one test per operation with working-path/refusal coverage and business assertions (workspace/.agents/skills/backend/testing.md:26-41, :132, :151-160). `packages/backend/test/features/api/shopping/test_api_shopping_operation_boundaries.ts:15-124` puts roughly a hundred accessors into one test and checks only a generic thrown-error refusal via lines 5-11; it supplies no operation-specific working paths or business effects. It also uses `any` and an `as (...args: any[])` cast at lines 5 and 124, expressly forbidden by testing.md:166-176. Unverified: unrelated implementation defects were not assessed because they are outside the two questions.

Question 1: No. The stream shows nonconforming rounds: Round 1 used partial `Select-Object -Skip/-First` reads (backend-remind-1.log:786-1477, 2933-4912), and the agent explicitly acknowledged splitting large files (backend-remind-1.log:4983, 28124, 40089). Later rounds also used range reads (backend-remind-1.log:12043-13493). The final raw-read round (backend-remind-1.log:56977-57391) and dry claim (59229) cannot cure earlier rounds that were not one-file-per-command full reads. Question 2: No. Workspace testing rules require one primary operation and at least one test per operation (workspace/.agents/skills/backend/testing.md:34-39), a business assertion in every test (line 158), and forbid direct Prisma reads for proof (line 172). The stream reports 107 accessors but only 12 scenarios (backend-remind-1.log:59229). `test_api_shopping_customer_join` and login only perform `typia.assert` shape checks without a business assertion (workspace/packages/backend/test/features/api/shopping/test_api_shopping.ts:24-51). The administration and business-journey functions bundle many operations into single tests (test_api_shopping_administration_edges.ts:24-152; test_api_shopping_business_journey.ts:26-646), and both directly query Prisma (administration_edges.ts:4,85; business_journey.ts:4,663).

However, the required packages/backend pnpm check:watch gate started at line 322856, emitted a watch-unavailable warning at 322861, and completed with status failed and exitCode 124 at 322905. The review skill requires a failed gate to invalidate the round and trigger another full round (workspace/.agents/skills/review/SKILL.md:71-73); no subsequent manifest/read round occurred before the final report at line 324094. Question 2: No. Testing instructions require one primary operation (testing.md:34-41), numbered behavior JSDoc/body steps (45), business assertions beyond typia shape checks (151-160), and prohibit direct Prisma setup/proof (172-175). Violations are present in test_api_shopping.ts:24-33 and 35-51 (shape-only registration/login), 121-137 and 153-173 (password changes with no business assertion), and 67-102 (address mutation without observable list/update proof); business_journey.ts:26-30 spans many operations and directly queries Prisma at 648-659; administration_edges.ts:24-25 spans many operations and directly queries Prisma at 85-88 and 161-164. Both questions therefore fail.
